description.value: Octopus Garden is a high-end omakase and sushi restaurant on Cornwall Avenue in Kitsilano, positioned near the popular seawall cycling route. The kitchen is known for sourcing exceptional Japanese ingredients — whole bluefin tuna heads delivered weekly, Kagoshima and Hida wagyu, Hokkaido sea urchin, and live Ise ebi — alongside premium Canadian products like BC oysters and Acadian sturgeon caviar. The restaurant celebrated 34 years in operation, though the current status of the business is uncertain.
